anya: just got a DSAR erase hit. eraser pipeline failed at decrypt step. suspect IAM tidy removed its key binding.
ravi: error snippet?
anya: 
ERROR: eraser: user=U-559 record=rec-993 status=FAILED reason=KMS.AccessDenied serviceAccount:eraser@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com missing cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt on projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/vec/cryptoKeys/emb-ck

zia: ops change last week removed some long-lived svcaccts. ops-oncall can you confirm?
ops-oncall: confirmed. authz-cleanup removed eraser@ on 2025-11-05T22:11:00Z. key current version is v5; previous v4 had binding. I can re-enable and grant decrypt scoped to that key for a 20m window if legal signs off.
legal-bot: policy: do NOT mutate snapshots until Privacy+Legal approve. require sealed evidence bundle and IAM audit diff.
anya: options: 1) temp grant + run purge (fast) 2) restore snapshot to secure project for manual erase (slower) 3) request retention-exception.
zia: recommend temp grant with strict scope + sealed logs. also change pipeline: on KMS failure mark FAILED_HOLD and notify privacy team.
anya: opening ticket SR-2026-9999 and attaching logs. tagging ops/legal/privacy. will update when approvals arrive. :lock:
